It hardcodes the three draft paths, asserts each contains `**Status:** Candidate draft` and matches `/do not publish/i` and does NOT match `**Status:** Approved|Effective`, checks local Markdown link existence, pins ~15 prose substrings, and blocks stale claims (`**Neon**`, `EU-West-3`, `point-in-time recovery with ≤15-minute`). It computes no digest, has no notion of approval, and is not wired into any release gate.

Gate F. `src/shared/release/gate-f-evidence.ts` already models `release.legalRevisionSet` as a bare `evidenceReferenceSchema` (`path`, `sha256`, `capturedAt`), and requires the `counsel` and `founder` approvals to carry `legalRevisionSetSha256` equal to it (lines 100-105, 215-224). It byte-verifies the referenced file in `validateGateFEvidenceBundle`. But the artifact is completely untyped: `validateTypedPromotionArtifact` (lines 355-408) only decodes three labels — `gates.promotion.deployed_critical_journeys.evidence.0`, `gates.promotion.canary_window.evidence.0`, `gates.promotion.restore_rollback.evidence.0` — and returns `[]` for everything else, so `release.legalRevisionSet` passes with any bytes. The test fixture proves it: `src/shared/release/gate-f-evidence.test.ts:129-132` binds `legal/revision-set.json` containing literally `{"privacy":"2026-08-28","terms":"2026-08-28"}`. Nothing checks status, document digests, effective dates, expiry, or approver identity. `scripts/release/validate-bundle.ts` contains zero occurrences of "legal"; it only delegates to `validateGateFEvidenceBundle`. There is no producer for the artifact anywhere in the tree.

Precedents that make this mechanical. `src/shared/merchant-ai-notice-contract.ts` already implements exactly the shape needed: a frozen payload, `MERCHANT_AI_NOTICE_VERSION`, a pinned `MERCHANT_AI_NOTICE_DIGEST`, `parseMerchantAiNoticeCatalogueEntry` that throws on digest mismatch, and DB-level pinning via CHECK constraints `merchant_ai_consent_evidence_notice_digest_valid` / `merchant_ai_enablement_notice_digest_valid` on tables `merchant_ai_consent_evidence` and `merchant_ai_enablement` (`notice_version`, `notice_digest`). `src/shared/release/recovery-rehearsal-evidence.ts` + `candidate-bound-evidence.ts` give the canonical-JSON, candidate-bound typed-evidence template. `scripts/review/comprehensive-program-status.ts` gives the JSON-ledger + Zod + CLI template. `src/shared/governance/` already hosts authority registries (`capability-fate.ts`, `data-fate-authority.ts`, `documentation-authority.test.ts`, `adr-index.test.ts`, `gate-wiring.test.ts`).

LIF-01-T14 must assert row-level deletion only; any DDL contraction belongs to CNV-01 after a verified release plus restore proof.

Dark-capability leakage: Portal upload, Contact Request, Recognition/badge/leaderboard, Team and Staff User contributors must return affirmative contributions and purge receipts without creating any activation path.
